The '''Fishing Guild''' is a [[members]]-only [[Guilds|guild]] located in a fenced area north of [[East Ardougne]]; west of [[Hemenster]], which was released on [[17 June]] [[2002]]. To enter, players must have a [[Fishing]] level of 68; [[Fishing#Temporary boosts|temporary boosts]] can be used to boost one's level in order to enter the guild, making the lowest level to possibly enter 62 using a [[super fishing potion]].

Historically, aside from [[Catherby]], the Fishing Guild has been one of the most popular places to fish because of the nearby [[Fishing Guild bank|bank]].

Outside of the guild is the [[Master Fisher]]. Players can talk to him to receive advice on training Fishing, or to purchase a [[Fishing cape]] for 99,000 coins.

While inside the guild, players will receive an invisible +7 level boost to their Fishing. This boost will stack with any existing boosts the player already has, such as the visible +3 boost from using the [[dragon harpoon]]'s [[special attack]], though visible boosts are capped to level 99.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1375844352098975753|date=27 March 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98237|archivedate=29 March 2021|quote=I did a little more trawling of the code, and can confirm that the visible stat is now treated as 99 if it's above 99 - that is a recent change. It seems to have been applied to Mining, Fishing and Woodcutting.}} However, the invisible boost '''will not''' allow a player to perform actions above their base level.

The guild is an excellent option for players hunting [[big fish]], since the [[big bass]], [[big swordfish]], and [[big shark]] are all obtainable from the fishing spots around the docks.

==Transportation==
The fishing guild is located south-west of [[Seers' Village]] and north of [[Ardougne]]. There are several transportation options
*Using a [[Skills necklace]] to teleport directly outside the front door.
*Teleporting to [[Camelot]] and running west through Seers' Village and then south-west through [[Hemenster]].
*Teleporting to Ardougne and running north (requires [[Plague City]]).
*Using the [[Lunar spells|lunar]] spell [[Fishing Guild Teleport]].
*Using a [[Combat bracelet]] to teleport to the [[Ranging Guild]] and run west.
*[[Kandarin headgear 3]]/[[Kandarin headgear 4|4]] teleport to [[Sherlock]] and running west.
*Using the [[Ardougne cloak 2]]/[[Ardougne cloak 3|3]]/[[Ardougne cloak 4|4]], teleport to the farming patch north of Ardougne and head west.
*Using the [[Fishing cape]] to teleport directly to the guild, just outside the house with the cooking range.

==Features==
===Entrance hall===
There is a [[range]], which players can use to [[Cooking|cook]] food. It is fairly close to a bank, but there is an everlasting fire directly next to the bank in the [[Rogues' Den]]. A [[lobster pot]], [[harpoon]], [[Small fishing net|small]] and [[big fishing net]] spawn here. There is also a ladder here, but there's nothing important up the ladder.

===Bank===
Players can access their [[Fishing Guild bank|bank]] here. It is connected to the fishing store. Notably, this is the closest bank to shark and lobster fishing spots. The bank is also a location used in [[Treasure Trails]]. Blowing a raspberry whilst completing a [[hard clue scroll]] causes a [[double agent]] to appear.

===Fishing store===
{{main|Fishing Guild Shop}}
There is a Fishing Guild Shop run by a man named [[Roachey]]. He has a supply of fishing bait (3 coins each) and feathers (2 coins each).

He will buy and sell player-stocked raw or cooked cod, mackerel, bass, tuna, lobster and swordfish.

===Docks===
There are about 11 [[Fishing spot (cage, harpoon)|cage, harpoon fishing spot]]s ([[lobster]]s and [[tuna]]/[[swordfish]]), and about 9 [[Fishing spot (big net, harpoon)|big net, harpoon fishing spot]]s ([[bass]], [[mackerel]], [[cod]], [[casket]], plus [[sharks]]) scattered around two docks. The northern dock is closest to the bank, whilst the southern dock is closest to the cooking range. There is also a [[man]] walking around on the northern dock. The northern dock usually has more cage/harpoon spots than the southern dock, whilst the southern dock usually has more net/harpoon spots, though there is a chance of the spots going on the opposite dock.

The guild is ideal for players fishing sharks, lobsters, tuna, and swordfish.

===Minnow platform===
[[File:Fishing Guild minnow platform.png|thumb|250px|A group of players on the platform fishing minnow.]]
In the northern platform, players can speak to [[Kylie Minnow]], who will take players to a platform containing [[minnow|minnows]]. To access this platform, players require level 82  in Fishing (which '''cannot''' be boosted), completion of the [[Fishing Contest]] [[quest]], and have an [[angler's outfit]] worn while speaking to her.
[[File:Flying fish.gif|left|thumb|180px|A flying fish gobbles up the player's minnow.]]
The platform contains four minnow spots, where they move 1 tile in a clockwise direction every fifteen seconds, meaning players must pay more attention to fishing minnows compared to other fishing methods. In addition, there is a chance a flying fish will eat some of the player's minnows, forcing players to move to another minnow fishing spot. Flying fish will only appear when the spot is first clicked. Therefore, when any player is already receiving minnows from a fishing spot there is no risk of a flying fish appearing for anyone on that spot until it moves.

The platform is not considered within the guild and thus does not benefit from the guild's invisible level boost.

For every forty minnows caught, Kylie will exchange them for one [[raw shark]].
